# Security policy

[Project README](../README.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

Do not report credentials, private paths, or personal data in public issues.
Use the repository host's private security-advisory mechanism for a suspected
vulnerability. Include the affected version, impact, and a minimal
non-sensitive reproduction.

No part of this package should execute user input through a shell.
